title: Double Perturbation: On the Robustness of Robustness and Counterfactual Bias Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual token substitution of gendered pronouns and nouns (e.g., he/she, actor/actress) within a double perturbation framework, measuring the shift in expected sentiment predictions across a generated neighborhood of similar sentences.
Evaluating sentiment prediction differences by substituting sexual orientation tokens (e.g., gay, straight) within neighborhood sentences constructed via masked language modeling.
Measuring expected prediction shifts by substituting race-associated demographic tokens within a generated local neighborhood of test sentences.
Using counterfactual token substitution of nationality terms (e.g., Asian, American) within the proposed double perturbation framework to evaluate prediction changes.
Measuring the shift in expected model predictions by substituting religion-related protected tokens in constructed counterfactual neighborhood examples.
